Frequently Asked Questions

How old is RJ Barrett?

RJ Barrett is 26 years old.

Where was RJ Barrett born?

RJ Barrett was born in Toronto, Ontario.

When was RJ Barrett born?

RJ Barrett was born on June 14, 2000.

How tall is RJ Barrett?

RJ Barrett is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much does RJ Barrett weigh?

RJ Barrett weighs 214 lbs (97 kg).

Is RJ Barrett in the Hall of Fame?

RJ Barrett is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was RJ Barrett drafted?

RJ Barrett was drafted by New York Knicks, 1st round (3rd pick, 3rd overall), 2019 NBA Draft.

What position does RJ Barrett play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

What is RJ Barrett's net worth?

RJ Barrett has made at least $112,980,204 playing professional basketball.

How much does RJ Barrett make?

RJ Barrett made $27,705,357 in 2026.

How many rings does RJ Barrett have?

RJ Barrett has won 0 championships.

What is RJ Barrett's Instagram account?

RJ Barrett is on Instagram at rjbarrett.

What schools did RJ Barrett attend?

RJ Barrett attended Montverde Academy in Montverde, Florida and Duke.

What are RJ Barrett's nicknames?

Maple Mamba, Ducky, Headband Ro, Star-J, Broadway Barrett, Duke of York are nicknames for RJ Barrett.
